description: Live performance metrics for the DPX settlement infrastructure — request volumes, error rates, growth trends, and per-service breakdown. On the hosted mcp.untitledfinancial.com Worker this reads Cloudflare's production telemetry directly. This npx package does not hold DPX's Cloudflare account token (it is never distributed with the public package), so it reports that live figures are unavailable here and points to the hosted endpoint or case@untitledfinancial.com for current numbers.
name: dpx.metrics
